# Spreadsheet preview fixtures

`any_sheets.xls`, `any_sheets.xlsx`, and `any_sheets.ods` are unmodified Calamine
fixtures from commit `0af05f4f6030351e3b8a999ea0810c8618368776`:
https://github.com/tafia/calamine/tree/0af05f4f6030351e3b8a999ea0810c8618368776/tests

Distributed under the accompanying MIT license. They contain numeric cells,
blank rows, a description of the workbook, and additional hidden/chart sheets.
The XLS fixture also contains VBA metadata; preview must never execute it.

SHA-256:

- XLS: `efb61c9a60b826b18b251cd74bb80819fcf8eb566e74ef6130709dcd2f7e0590`
- XLSX: `fba48e0141f847d80738a4417f0a336cba92e4ac692d8dd7516eac41e32c9e4f`
- ODS: `1aef869b5e34ad735010ca37a27fcf081824fd45d2af351542a74d03e3fed01d`
